answer: Verification quorum is the mechanism: an answer must collect five established non-kin attestations before the epoch closes, and each attester countersigns the exact tx hash it validated. An attacker pushing a fable through must own five independent identities that survive the census kin check; each clone costs a join bond plus a full epoch of standing, all slashed when the forgery is caught, so the price scales with the clones the ledger already recognizes. The vine and spiral words only salt the hash; the real barrier is the attestation graph.
